item.text: I’m using `ruler-evidence-researcher` because this is a lens-by-lens, cited evidence note with source mapping rather than a code change.

**8B.4 Research Note**

**Assessment:** Lean yes, with clear patronage caveats. In 2024 Marcos did select and empower a real cadre of capable economic and security managers, and he sometimes pushed the bureaucracy to discipline weak performers. But the broader ruling network still ran through family/coalition channels, so the pattern was mixed rather than purely meritocratic.

- [Speech of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. At the Oath-taking and Announcement of the New Department of Finance Secretary and Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs](https://pco.gov.ph/presidential-speech/speech-of-president-ferdinand-r-marcos-jr-at-the-oath-taking-and-announcement-of-the-new-department-of-finance-secretary-and-special-assistant-to-the-president-for-investment-and-economic-affairs/) | Presidential Communications Office | January 12, 2024 | Marcos announced Ralph Recto and Frederick Go as key economic appointments and framed them as consequential for the country’s economic direction; Go was explicitly brought in from the private sector. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.2

- [Recto hits the ground running towards an inclusive future that benefits all Filipinos, introduces growth-enhancing roadmap in his first 100 days in office](https://www.dof.gov.ph/recto-hits-the-ground-running-towards-an-inclusive-future-that-benefits-all-filipinos-introduces-growth-enhancing-roadmap-in-his-first-100-days-in-office/) | Department of Finance | April 29, 2024 | Recto said Marcos gave him room to recalibrate fiscal targets and that he was working with a “highly talented and competent” DOF team. This is strong evidence that Marcos empowered a capable economic lead rather than using the post as a ceremonial loyalist slot. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.2

- [Marcos economic team lays out plans to safeguard PH economy](https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1228524) | Philippine News Agency | July 8, 2024 | Marcos’s economic managers, including Balisacan, Remolona, Go, Recto, and budget officials, publicly coordinated strategy on inflation, growth, and investment. This supports the claim that he gave technocrats real responsibility over the core program. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.2, 8B.3

- [CSC takes action to extend eligibility for JO, COS workers](https://csc.gov.ph/csc-takes-action-to-extend-eligibility-for-jo-cos-workers) | Civil Service Commission | May 2, 2024 | The civil service system turned Marcos’s directive into a skill-and-eligibility program for long-serving contract workers, aimed at qualifying them for permanent posts. That is evidence of building a more capable bureaucracy rather than simply patronage hiring. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

- [PBBM Signs Laws on Streamlining Procurement, Combatting Online Scams](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/) | Presidential Communications Office | July 20, 2024 | Marcos signed procurement reforms that standardized forms and institutionalized e-procurement, reducing discretion and favoritism in state purchasing. That suggests he empowered administrators through rules, not just personal loyalists. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.2, 8B.3

- [Executive Order No. 81](https://lawphil.net/executive/execord/eo2024/eo_81_2024.html) | Lawphil / Office of the President | December 30, 2024 | Marcos reorganized the National Security Council into a more structured body with cabinet, legislative, military, intelligence, and legal members. This is good evidence that he relied on institutional security coordination rather than a purely personal inner circle. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

- [PBBM stands by suspension of 139 NFA officials](https://pia.gov.ph/press-release/pbbm-stands-by-suspension-of-139-nfa-officials/) | Philippine Information Agency | March 7, 2024 | Marcos backed the suspension of 139 NFA officials over anomalous rice sales and procedural violations. That shows willingness to discipline underperforming or noncompliant administrators instead of shielding them. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

- [Ralph Recto is new DOF chief, to take oath Friday, says wife Vilma](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/893820/ralph-recto-is-new-dof-chief-to-take-oath-friday-wife-vilma/story/) | GMA News Online | January 11, 2024 | Recto was a seasoned political insider, not a pure technocrat. The appointment still may have been competent, but it weakens any claim that Marcos selected only apolitical experts. | QIDs: 8B.4

- [Marcos, Romualdez parties forge political alliance](https://www.bworldonline.com/the-nation/2024/05/08/593686/marcos-romualdez-parties-forge-political-alliance/) | BusinessWorld Online | May 8, 2024 | Marcos’s party and Martin Romualdez’s party formed a formal alliance for the 2025 midterms, showing that the ruling network still fused family power, coalition management, and state strategy. That is evidence against a clean merit-only staffing or ruling model. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

- [Philippines](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | June 17, 2024 | The report says TeleRadyo Serbisyo formed a joint venture with Prime Media associated with the Romualdez family, while the state also flexed regulatory power over broadcasters. This is indirect but real evidence that politically connected networks still mattered under Marcos. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

- [Philippines | Freedom in the World 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/philippines/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House says patronage and kinship still shape Philippine politics, elites have structural advantages, and anticorruption bodies struggle to hold powerful actors accountable. That is the broadest counterweight to a strong meritocratic reading of Marcos’s staffing and empowerment choices. | QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

**Search gap:** I did not find public HR files, appointment scorecards, or internal performance reviews that would let me measure systematically whether Marcos favored competence over loyalty across the full bureaucracy. The clearest evidence is concentrated in the economic and security core; lower-level staffing remains opaque.
